Mare Davi akore oino ji ature itae atoriga rairewu tabo, ako meriri oto tabo, onare aiwu meriri aiarewu tabo; imirema karega, itumode atogi Pao ro rakarewu ie tabo, Israel o tugobaigarege eno Aroe Eimejera apagudukare cewu.

Pao umode amagu ikera kai awu meriji, imode awududo, imode akidoru kado, imode atugarege ekodu maku baru tadawu kiege barege etai, boe tadawu barege etai. Moto jamedu kejeboe eerduwamode ia Aroe Eimejerai Israeldoge etada duji.
Boe eiamedu boe eerduwamode Pao umodukae boedo tumorido tariga rairewu tabo, meriri oto tabo duji; paga karega Paore rugodumode, umode tamagu cegera kai.

Filisteu ui tuburedo Davi togi dukeje, awure tudawuje tumedage epiji, rekodure nowu filisteu togi, ure tugera tugu tumiciguto, ure ia tori tawuje, ure barigu to aroia baibai tabo, jeture filisteu jeriji. Torire turemo jerito, Icare nowu imedu kurirewu enojore tuwudu tabo.
Oinore Davire tumorido filisteuji to aroia baibai tabo, tori tabo, ure butudo, ure bito toriga bokwa tabo.

Du keje Icare Davi rekodure jii padurewo kae, ure tuwarigu keje, ure tugeragu utoriga raireuji, ure tawuje tuia piji, ure itoru kado. Icare filisteudoge, tuiordui tugimejera butui tuwi tabo duji dukeje, eregodure.

Nowu du kodi, ei tugirimi Davii filisteu bito dupiji dukeje, Israeal kejewu bakurirewu jamedu boe kejewu areme ere tuiebu tureru tabo, turagodu tabo Saul jokorai, to ka boe tabo, meriri kiarewu tabo, tui boe eerdudo tuiegarae jitu tabo.
Areme ererure turagodu tabo, tagoi oino dutabo saulre bitowugere mil, mare Davire bitowugere dez mil.

Nowu inodu ukare turugadu Saul ji; du kodi Icare korigodure, akore ere dez mil maku Davi ai, inai ere mil maku tu rugadu; kaboba okware ewo tugimejerado ema? Nowu meri piji, Saul aiwo pemagakare Davi ji pugeje.
Saulre tonaregedu Jonas biie, ure tudugarege eiamedu boe ewiie, tumearudaeie tuwo Davi bito duji.
Mare Jônatas, Saul naregedu, mearudu kurire Davi ji.

Ure Davido tumearudu awadudo pudui, tagoi oino jitu tabo ioga Saul jemarure tuwo awido, du kodire ire awiie, kuri barogwato atuwo ia boe biarewu kae, awo awiado. Imi, imode itawuje, imode iragoje puredudo iogaji, imode awiie boemodedu jameduji.

Jônatas makore Davi paru tabo tuo Saul biagai, dutabo Icare akore oino pugeje akaidu kaba aro pegawo atugare Davi ji, paga karega, ro pegakare ai, rore aiboe pemegaguragare. Biapagakai tuwimode duji, ure filisteu bito, ure Israeldogedo tumorido filisteudogei. Aerdure, aegarere. Inoba ure kodiba akaidure awo akera kudo boe eku pemegarewu tabo, ai Davi bito ia ro pegarewu bokwa tabo?
Saul biapagare Jônatas akoi pudui duji, ure tuwadaru maku Pao jerewu koia, bimodukare.
Icare Jônatas makore Davi bogai, readodure awu jamedu boeji biagai, Du kejere ure reko Saul ae, dure Icare maragodure ai, tumaragodui jao du reore.
Nowu du kodi, Saulre tugeragu meture tudodawu Israeldoge ei 3. 0 ceduji, uture Davi bogai, apowuge ewogai cabritodoge emugure kejewu torekaridoge etae, meri rutu jaogwai.
Taregodui ia ibora padui awara okwai, Saulre turemo ia tori poroto mugui nonodu tuwo tuwure amudo; Davi mugure pudabowuge ebo nowu tori poro opo keje.
Du kodi Icare Davi utugarege egore oino ji meri aregodure Pao akoi tumoduie onare aiwu maku akera kai. Du kodi Icare Davire turagojedo, utu podure Saul ae, ure ukudae okwa kado.
Mare turoi oino dukeje, Davi tori buture jagi, tui Saul kudae okwa kado du kodi.
Akore oino tudugaregei Pao ukawo irowo oino Ikimijeraji, Paore tugeragu ji pudaiwu imeduji. Pao ukawo ido ikera oagado ji, Paore tugeragu ji pudai kodi.
Nowu tuwadaru tabo, Davikare tudugaregedo taredo Saul keje. Icare Saulre tudawuje nowu tori poro piji, uture tudawaraji pugeje.

Du keje Icare Davire turagojedo jamedu, tui tuiebu tori poro piji dutabo, oiogwarire Saul rekodaji, tagoi oino dutabo. Ikimejera, boe eimejera! Saul aiwore tuibagi, Icare Davire tuie jodo mototo tuwo tubujodo ji.
Du rekodaji Davi akore oino Saul ji kodiba awiapagare boe egoi: 'Davi aidure tuwo boe pegado ai? ' oino duji?

Ca! Awuji aeku jordure Paoi amagu ikera kai tori poro tada duji, boere turugadu iwo awido du bogai. Mare irokare ino, imagore oino ii imodukare ikera aogado Ikimejera ji, Paore tugeragu ji pudai kodi.
Akaiwodo ikedui akudae okwa kobo jituji. Ii akudae okwa kado ikai awido dutabo, du kodire amode boe pa imearudae pegakai, iro pegakai ai duji. Dure karega, akonare ii awo iwido.
Pao umode tugogado ai, ii; umode togwamorido ai iparu tabo. Mare ikera padumodukare awugeje jii je.
Bakaru mariguduwu ako magadu reore: 'Ro pegareuge epijire boe pegarewu aregodure'; mare ikera puredumodukare ai.
Ioguduba jiba Israeldoge eimejera rugodumode? Ioguduba jiba akonare? Ia arigao birewu rabodu, ia kuieje rabodu?
Pao umode tugogado pai puibagi, uwo tugogado akonai ii duji.
Davi ui tuwadaru akedudo dukeje, Saul akore oino bataru jipagi itonaregedu Davi, awadaru na?
Icare ragudu kuricigore.
Du keje akore oino Davi ji akire aro jetoro kodure iro jetorogodu kori; paga karega, aki aro pemegare ii, imirema, iro boe pega kuricigodo ai.
Awuji are iordudo aro pemegai ii duji. Paore imagu akera kai, mare akare iwido.
Ioguduba jordumode onare jiwuji ma, umode utu pemegado tudawaraji pugeje? Du kodire Pao umode aiwo pemegado aroi ii duji.
Icare iorduwa jokodure akie aetumode boe ji duji. Israeldoge eimejerage ekedure jiboe mugumode akera keje.

Nowu du kodi, Israeldoge eimejera kurirewu Saul uture toro boe makodurewu iere Zif cedu kae, tuwo tuwu Davi otogajeje nowu boe makodurewu tada. O tugobaigaregere 3. OOO, duwugere eroiwa kodure tumedage eroiwa kori Israel moto keje.

Icare Davi mare metuia Abisai eture boecoji jii ere baadowo kae, eerdure Saul padui tunu tabo duji, o meriri otowu meture moto tada, aora padurewu jaogwai; Saul metuia, iere Abner cedu, mare utugarege, enu padu bire oiei.
Icare Abisai akore oino Davi ji awuji Paore onare aiwu maku akera kai. Ido o meriri oto bu kajeje mito tu je mototo, boe emodukare boe bu kajeje pobe.
Mare Davi akore oino Abisai ji ioguduba umode tugera bu Paore tugera bu kejewu keje, duma boe keadu modukare ji?

Icare Davire tugeragu rakojere Saul ao jaogwaiwu meriri otoji, pobo jaji, eture tabo. Boe eerdukare iaboeji iaboeji, boe ekare boe pa boe oino duji, iaboe iaboe eedadukare, eiamedu boe enudu nure, paga karega, Paore ewarigu nore kori jaoto kodi.
Davire pagado bakowu kae, ure turagojedo ia tori kudu ao keje jaegiri, boe jaegirire pubuji puae.
Icare Davi oiogwarire, akore Pagimejera o meriri oto reo. Ia iparedu boe tagi, mato kae.
Pao umode paiwo aidugirido puibagi, paro pamearutoru reore. Paore tamagu ikera kai awu meriji, mare itaidukare iwo ikera aogado Pao Aroe Eimejera o kruca padure kejewuji.
Nowu du kodi, Davire tugirimi tui amalecitadoge eeda kedodo dupiji, merire pobe ji Siqueleg keje.

Merii pobe ma jewu metuia bokware durekodaji Saulre baadodu pijire ia imedu aregodure tugudae bodu tabo, ao korobadure moto urugudu tabo; taregodui Davi ae dukeje, ure tuie jodo mototo, ure tubujodo ji.
Davi unoragodure ji kaba pijiba akaregodure? Akore oino iregodure Israeldoge ere baadodu piji.
Davi akore ji areadodudo iwiegai inoba boere tai toro? Akore oino ji boe eregodure turugodu piji, makareuge ewudure, ewire; Saul bire jamedu tonaregedu Jônatas apo.
Du kodi Icare Davire tugeragu tugudaeji, ure bowuje. Mugure apowuge eiamedu boe erore ino jamedu.
Etoragudure, ekare boe ko meri rekodu kae, Saul, Jônatas, eregodaji, Pao uwobe Israel kejewuge eregodaji, ewidodure tariga rairewu tabo kodi.
Icare Davi akore oino Israel! Oinore ako tugobaigarege kurireuge ewudure boe padui tugajeje ako boe aoporu boe keje!
Saul, Jônatas, boe emearudu kurire jiwuge, akaru kurireuge; boe ee, boe ewi, ekare edo tugera ra pubiji. Ekodu raka kodure aroecebadoge ekori, ero raka kodure adugo agareuge ekori.
Israel ore areme tagoragududo Saul okwa rekodaji, ure tagudae kurukururewu tugu tai, ure tagudae motudo meriri ekurewu tabo.
Kodiba ewudure tumedui tudoda dutabo, turugodu oiado? Kodiba iwie Jônatas bitodure Israeldoge eno aoporu keje?
Iwie Jônatas, iwabo ragudure aregodaji, imearudu kurire ai kodi. Amearudu kuri pemega kodure areme emearudu kuriae kori!
Oinore tugobaigarege ro rakareuge ewudure, oinore boe erugodure taboboe akedure!

Nowu du kodi, Pao makore Natã ji, akore ji toro, akagodo oino itugare Davi ji oinore Pao akore ako merimode turugadu dukeje, amugumode aomage ebo dukeje, imode ia aregodajiwu mugudo amuga keje, ia aregodure apijiwu imode boe eimejerado ema. Umode ia bai to inai, imode boe eimejerado ema jii je. Uo rumode imi, itonaregedu rumode ema. Awai, aetui boeidu, umode jii je iegai, amuga rakojemode jii je, jamedu.

Nowu du kodi, Israel uwobe epadui pumekejedu jamedu boe eture Davi ae, tagoi oino jitu tabo cegireo, ara, akodu, nure cegi. Marigudu, Saul jetui cei kimo dutabo, akire are Israeldoge erego tu tu je. Pao akore oino ai 'Akire aetumode iwobe Israeldogei, eimejeramode aki'.
Du kodi Icare Israel kejewu boe codureuge eiamedu boe eture boe eimejera bogai Hebron kae. Icare Davire tuwadaru maku etai Pao jekai. Du kodi Icare ere Israeldoge eimejerado Davice.
Davi o jorure trinta, turudui Israeldoge eimejarai pudumi du kae. Jorure 40 jetui ei dutabo.

Hebron keje jeture Judá kejewugei jorure ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, arire ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto. Jerusalém keje jeture Israeldogei, Judá kejewuge eiamedu boeji, jorure 33 cedu tabo.

Davi uture Jerusalém kae tudugarege ebo, mugure torowu jebuseudoge etogi, duwuge egore oino Davi ji amodukare aremo woe; joku bokwareuge, pogora bokwareuge, emode awarigu. Dure oino Davi umodukare turemo woe.
Mare Davire tugeragu Sião kejewu bakurirewu moto ri onare jiwuji, dure Icare Davi o bakurirewu rema.
Davi ro rakagodure gu gu je, Pao utugare makarewu rakojere apo kodi.
Nowu du kodi, Davi uture tuwo Pao o boe eroiagudu meture tadawu irá reko tuiegare kuricigo tabo Obe-Edom uwai piji Davi o bakurirewu kae du bogai.
Ure nowu irá pemegarewu rekowuge etui tabo dukeje kuri je, ere ia tapira imedu karewu bito ia barogo kuguri karewu apo.
Davi rerure tuduru jamedu boe tabo Pao jekai, tui ia aroia kigadurewu kuru kururewu tugu pudui dutabo.
Davire nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu reko Israeldoge eiamedu boe ebo, toiogwari tabo, meriri iworewu ako utonaji.
Du kodi Icare ere Pao o irá pemegarewu reko, ere mugudo tumugumodewo kae, Davire pemegadowu aroia bai oiadoda.
Du keje ure tomea maku Pao ai.
Nowu ei tomea akedudo dukeje, Davire togwamu boe ji, Pao ro rakarewu ie tabo.
Du keje Icare Davire tapira kodu maku, amirewu tabo, parera tudu kirewu torudodu tabo boe eiamedu boe etai israeldoge eiamedu boe, ime, areme, etai. Du kejere eiamedu boe eture tu tu tuwai kae.

Brae Eimejera Davi ui tumugudo tuwai kurirewu tada dukeje, onare jiwu eedure oieiwuge epemegai ji Pao koia dutabo, akore oino profeta Natã ji akaiwodo, imugure bai noakodu irá cedu tada; Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure kejewu ira pemegarewu mugui bai aroia kuda du tonaji.
Icare Natã akore ji u! Ema rugadu! Meture awabo tadaboe jamedu boe towuje; paga karega, Pao rakojere akabo.
Nowu du kodi, Pao makore Natã ji, tagoi oino dutabo:
Toro! Amagodo itugare Davi ji: 'Oinore Pao akore Amearudaere awo ia bai towuje imugace?
Boe jokodu, ii Israeldoge etawuje Egito piji dupiji jii oino, iwai bokware imugace, mare imerure aroia bai boe tada, bairogu boe tada.
Ikodui Israel ore ebo jii oino du kae, imago kana ia ire jetudo iwobeiwugei: 'Kodiba akare ia bai towuje inai nowakodu irá cedu tabo? '

Icare akagomode oino itugare Davi ji oinore Pao utugare makarewu akore Ire atawuje boku piji, aetui barege kugurei dupiji, iwobe Israeldoge eimejerawo aki du bogai; amerurewo jamedu boe keje iragojere akabo.
Ire onare aiwuge eiamedu boe eeda kedodo akododai, ire akagaru kuricigodo, ia brae eimejerage kurireuge etagaru reore.
Imode iwobe Israeldoge eedado turugadu, nono Icare imode edo tuwure tugu eeduwo nono jii je, boe ekawo emorora amagadudo pudui pugeje.
Ro pegareuge eroreru modukare ei, uwo magai ire boe eimejerage jorduwareuge eetudo iwobe Israeldogei dukeje du reore. Imode amugu butugudo, imode ado akinorudo onare aiwuge epiji.
Paore awie pudumie tumode ia bai mugudo akai.
Ako meri aregodui pudae dukeje, amugumode kodure akododaiwuge ebo dukeje, imode aregodajiwu, umode tudowuje apijiwu aogado, imode boe eimejerado ema.
Emare umode ia bai towuje inai, imode boe eimejerado ema jii je.
Uomode imi, itonaregedumode ema. Ro jetorogodu modukare ma, imode okorido iwara tabo, ime ero magai pui, tui boe to ro jetorokareugei dutabo, du reore.
Mare imodukare iro pemegarewu jaedo ji, iro magai Saul jitu reore, dure ire barigu akoda piji.
Awai, boe eimejerai akidu, umode jii je iegai, amuga rakamode jii je.

Natã readodure Davi biegai awu Pao bataru jameduji. Natã makoi Davi jitu rekodaji, boe eimejerare turemo Pao uwaito, tui turagojedo Pao jekai dutabo, akore ioguduba ure imi, Pao Aroe Eimejera, ioguduba iwobere emage, awo irego jii awu boe oino du kae?
Mare awu inodu ukare turugadu aegai roga, Ioga Aroe Eimejera, are aromodedudo kimo atugare uwobei ia jaegiri aregodumodeboe kae.
Are awobe Israeldoge awobedo emage jii je, ino Aroe Eimejera, are eno Aroe Eimejerado aki.
Oinore Icare, Pao Aroe Eimejera, akagoi atugare jitu, uwobe eidu, boe jokodudo jii je, boe ko awadaru rekodaji.
Akagaru kuriwo jii je du bogai, boe egowo Pao ro rakarewu, Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera nure ema. Atugare Davi uwai muguwo jii je aegai.

Paga karega, akire Pao utugare makarewu, Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera, are boe awadudo atugare biegai, akagoi oino dutabo imode ia bai towuje akai. - Du kodire, atugarere tudugu tudo togwamaguduwo oino ai.

Du kodire, Ikimejera, Aroe Eimejera nure aki, boe rikirewu nure awadaru rema. Aromode atugare aiboe pemegarewu kuricigo, makaguragare; du kodire oino akogwamu atugare uwaiji, muguwo jii aegai. Atugare uwai pemegamode jii je, ai akogwamu jitu dutabo, akire akagore aromoduie oino du kodi.

Rekodajiwu joru keje, brae eimejera etu eture turugodu kae dukejere, Davire tudugare Joab utudo tugobaigarege eimejerage ebo Israeldoge eiamedu boe etae, duwugere, tui amonitadoge eno moto pegado dukeje, ere bakuredo Rabat bakurireuji. Davi rema mugure Jerusalém keje eiageje.
Ia meri rekodu tabo, Davire turagojedo tuba piji, merure tuwai aogajejewu boe boareuji, dutabore jordure ia aredui taimo duji. Aredu motu rakaguragareudo nure ema.
Ure boe enarago kakoduwu areduba. Icare biedodure betsabéia rema, Eliam naregedu, Urias heteu oreduje.
Du kodi Icare ure boe erojai bogai ewo arego pudae gore; Betsabeia ure ema, Elian naregedu, Urias ‘eteu’ oreduje. Du keje, Davi ure utugaege edo rego padae. Aregodu keje, unudure apo.
Du keje Betsabéia ure tugirimi tuwai kae. Tuguiaru keje, ure Davi biie, tagoi oino dutabo ikuiarure.
Du kodi Icare Davire boe emagodo oino Joabji Urias heteu utudo mato iwogai. Joabre Urias utudo Davi bogai rugadu.
Uriai Davi jordudo pudui dukeje, unoragodure ji Joab jiboeji, tugobaigarege eiboeji, inoba boere toro turugodu tabo.
Du keje Icare akore oino Urias ji. Arawuje awai kae, awure kabi. Uriasre tudawuje nowu tugimejera uwai piji; rekodaji ia nowu boe eimejera o mea rekodudodure bogai.
Mare Urias unudure boe eimejera uwai poro keje ia tugimejera utugarege ebo, ukare turawuje tuwai kae.
Ere Davi biie tagoi oino jitu tabo uriaskare turawuje tuwai kae. Divi unorara Uriaji akaregodukare jae piji? Kodiba atukare awai kae?
Uria akore Pao o Arca, Isral, Judá, emugu nure aroia kuda, Joab mãe Ikimejera otugobaigarege.
Emugure baawadu keje, imirema, imirema, kodiba aitumode iwai kae inogwagewo, ikuduwo, inuduwo itoreduje apo? Iromodukare inoduji iaboe keje iaboe keje.
Do kodire Davi akore ji, amugudo woe awuji, borogwato amerumode aibagi. Urias mugure nowu meriji kimo Jewrusalém tada.
Nowu meri rekodaji, Davire okwagedo, kududo pudabo, nono ure aora baibaido. Boecoji, Uriasre tudawuje, ure tuwu tugimejera utugarege etoiadoda, mare ukare turawuje tuwai ake.
Nowu rekodaji pugejewu meriji, Davire bapera atugodo Joab bogai, ure Uriasdo reko.
Nowu bapera atugo keje akore Urias rakojedo boe erugodui puidu pegarewu oiadoda, okoridoduwo ma, biwo du bogai.
Toebatodui bakurirewu jitu dutabo, Ure Urias rakojedo ime emedure tadawuge etogi.
Nowu jeture bakurirewu jiwu tugobaigarege erugodure Joabji, ia Davi utugarege, ia tugobaigarege ewire. Urias heteu meture bireuge etada jamedu.
Nowu du kodi Paore Profeta Natã utudo Davi ae; taregodui ae dukeje, akore oino ji ia bakurirewu keje, imere pobe: ia oroe kurire, ia marenaru rema.
Nowu oroe kurirewu aku tapiradoge, barege kugure, emagaguragare.

Dure karega, cewu marenaru aku barogo rogu ure mito tu je; ure akirodo ji, ure okwagedo, ure ricodudo pudabo, torebo; ure togwagere jiboe, tugudure ceboe maku ai jamedu, unudure kubi, ure nono onaregeduie ure ema.

Boekarema, iaboe etaregodure nowu oroe kurirewu uwai kae, aidukare tuwo ia tagu tapira, ia tagu barege kugure ewido tuwo tugera pemegado ji nowu aregodure pudaewu okwagewo ji pudabo; du kodire Icare ure tugeragu nowu marenaru aku barogo roguji, ure tugera pemegado ji, nowu aregodure pudaewu okwagewo ji pudabo.

Du kodi Icare Davi korigodu kuricigore nowu imedu bogai, akore oino Natã ji. Pao jerewu ie koia, nowu rore oinowu imedu bitodu rumode, umode nowu barogo morido pobe puibiji, nowu ro pegai oinodu koia, mare okudukare boebo kodi.
Icare Natã akore oino Davi ji nowu imedu nure aki! Awiapagado Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera akoi aiduji ire Israeldoge eimejerado aki, ire akinorudo Saul iera piji, ire akimejera uwai maku akai.
Ire uwire emagu akera kai, ire Israeldoge, Judá kejewuge eimejerado aki. Aerdu kuri modukare awu inoduji ma, imode ia akaidure jiboe maku akai kimo.
Kodiba aro pemegakare ako Aroe Eimejera jekai? Are boedo Urias Heteu bito tariga rairewu tabo, are akeragu oredujeji akai.
Tariga rairewu jae modukare awai piji, are boe kado imi, ai akeragu Urias heteu toreduje ji akai, ai amonitadogedo Urias bito tariga rairewu tabodu kodi.
Du kodi Icare Pao akore oino imode awai pijiwu iaboe etonado ai. Imode ikeragu awirei aegai, imode emagu onare aiwu ai, mugumode ebo meri rugu keje.
Paga karega, aro oinodu biadodure, mare imi awu inodu to Israeldoge eiamedu boe eegai meri rugu keje.
Du kodi Icare Davi ureadodure turo pegareuji Natã biegai, tagoi oino dutabo iro pegare Pao ji.
Icare Natã akore oino ji Pao butugugodure aro pegareuji, du kodire awimodukare.
Mare awu aro oino dutabo, are Pao korigodu kuricigodo aro pegareuji, du kodire botumode akaiwu akonaregedu bimode.
Natãre tugirimi tuwai kae, Icare Urias oreduje onaregedu botui Davi aiwu kogodu kuricigore.
Icare Davi okwamagudure Pao ji nowu negedurogu paru tabo, ukare boe kowuje; tui tugirimi tuwai kae dutabo, unudure moto keje.
Uwai tadawu codureugere tuburedo ji tuwo udo turagojedo moto piji; mare aidukare, okwagekare ebo jamedu.
Nowu du kodi, bakaru aregodure Davi bogai israeldoge ewabore tuie jodo Absalão keje.

Du kodi Icare Davi akore oino jeture pudabo Jerusalém kejewu tudugaregei taragojedo, paregoduwo, paroiwa modukare pawo paginorudo Absalão koda apiji. Tadu marigudu! Umodukare ino ma, umode paeto pui, umode boe pegado pai, umode bakurirewu kejeboe bito tariga rairewu tabo.
Davi rutu nure Oliveira aoporu kujeto; ragudu nure turudu tabo, aroia padui tao keje dutabo, tuwure kedo tabo. Kodure apowu boe eiamedu boe aroia padure etao keje, erudure apo toragudu tabo.
Nowu boe eimejera aregodui Baurim kae dukeje, ia Saul uwobe imedu ure tudawuje nowu piji, iere Semei, Gera onaregedu, tumago pega tabo Davi ji.
Ure tori to ji, apowu tugaregei jamedu, boe eiamedu boe, utugobaigarege eiamedu boe, emerure jaogwai puibiji, kodi karega.
Tumago pegai jitu tabo, Semei akore toro, toro! Ure boe eku redowu imedu pegarewu.

Paore Saul uwai pijiwu boe eku butudo awugeje, are barigu tumuga piji kodi, du kodire ure boe eimejerage ekedure jiboe maku akonaregedu Absalão iera kai. Jeonare aiwu boe pegarewu makudure akai, ure boe eku redowu imedu nure aki kodi.
Du keje Icare Abisai, Servia naregedu, unoragodure nowu boe eimejeraji kodiba awu arigao birewu inodu mako pegare ikimejera boe eimejeraji? Ido itoru kado ii toriga rairewu to ji mito tu je dutabo.
Mare nowu boe eimejera akore inoba ure kodiba aerdure oino ii akagowo oino, Servia naregedu? Mako pegawo ii rugadu. Pao koiare ure akodo oino Davi ji; ioguduba akomode oino Pao ji kodiba aro oino?

Du kodi Icare Davi akore oino Abisai ji, tudugarege eiamedu boe ji icare itonaregedu, boture ipijiwu, aidure tuwo iwido; kode benjaminita aidu modukare aidu kori? Mako pegado rugadu, Pao koiare ure akodo oino. Ia dukeje Pao aiwomode togudu tabo ii, umode boe pemegado ii, awu boe egoi oino ii dutabo.
Kodi Icare, Davi uture tododai tudugarege ebo.

Nowu du kodi, Absalão jeture pa je Davi utugobaigarege eimejeragei, mugure ia burrico keje, dure ure tudugu ia carvalho itura boe kuda. Absalão aore tubodo nowu itura tabo, Icare bararere baru otoji moto piji, nowu mugure kejewu burrico uture todobiji.
Ia imedu jordure ji, ure Joab biie, tagoi oino dutabo iordure Absalão bararei ia carvalho itura jituji.
Icare Joabre tugeragu tudugoi pobe ma jewu metuia bokware duji, du ure bu Absalão morora kajeje.

Davi mugure baiporodoge emugure pujeto dukeje. Oeaiwore jiwu utugare ruture nowu boe boarewu mugui baiporo aogejedu kae, dutabo ure tuie aogado ma, jordure ia imedu kodui turegodu tabo tuginoigodu duji.
Nowu oeaiwore jiwu oiogwarire, ure boe eimejera biie, dure akore tuginoigodu ro oino ma, bakaru tabore ro oino.
Icare boe eimejera akore oino ji awure taru gu oino, awudugudo aregodu bogai.

Ure tuwure taru gu oino, upagare bogai turagoje tabo. Nowu cusita aregodure, akore oino boe eimejeraji bakaru pemegarewu tabore iro oino, ikimejera boe eimejera, paga karega, Paore tugogado onare aiwuge eiamedu boe ji.

Icare boe eimejera unoragodure nowu Etiópia kejewuji iparedu Absalão inorudodure? Pemegare? Icare nowu aregodurewu akore oino ji onare ikimejera jiwuge, ure tugera aogado tuwo boe pegado aidu eiamedu boe eiwo pegawo nono nowu iparedu jiwo pega reore.
Du kodi icare tori buture nowu boe eimejera jagi, icare, rutui tumuga mugure baiporo aogejedu kae dukeje, ragudure.
Icare, tumeru tabo, akore oino; Itonaregedu Absalão, Itonaregedu Absalão, itonaregedu Absalão! Iwiia amugato! Absalão itonaregedu! Itonaregedu!
Icare Joab biedodure tugimejera ragudui tonaregedu bitoduji.
Du kodi Icare nowu ei tumoridodu, nowu utugarege eiamedu boe ekiarigodae rema Paga karega, nowu meri keje boe emearudure boe eimejera kiarigodui tonaregedu rekodaji duji.
Nowu kodi, boe eimejera Davi akore oino Joabji, tugobaigarege eedui apo duji tadudo, tagaiwodo Israeldoge eedurewu boeji, Dã piji jii Bersabéia kae, boe eremagu, iorduwawo kaba kejeba enodo padure.
Joabre nowu enodo padui bapera kejedu maku nowu boe eimejera ai: tugobaigarege enodo padure 8. 0 keje, roiware tariga rairewu tabowuge Israel ai; Judá aiwu imere 5...

Tui boe eremagu durekodaji, Davi kiarigodure turo oino duji, akore oino Pao Aroe Eimejera ji iro pega kuricigore awu iro oino dutabo, mare oino, Ikimejera, awudugugo atugare ro pegarewu keje, iro pegare itaora baibai tabo kodi.
Ia meri keje kuri barogwato, Davire turagojedo, Pao makoi profeta Gad, Davi uwariji, tagoi oino dutabo, du tonaji:
Toro, amagodo Davi ji: - Oinore Pao akore imode iaboedo pobe ma jewu metuia bokware aegai: akeragu akaidure jiwuji, imode to.

Du kodi Icare Gad ure tuburedo Davi ji, akore ji inoba akaidure boewo ai? - Boe eke boi butuwo boe ewugeje jorui pobe ma jewu metuia bokware dutabo? - Iarema aregoduwo ari pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du tonaji onare aiwuge etododai eemarui awogai dutabo? - Iarema boe ekogodae pegarewu jetuwo jorui pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du reore aeture jiwu moto keje? Amearudaedo, awiatugu inoba inagomode ure irojaiwu biagai.
Davi akore oino Gadji ikiarigodu kuricigore, mare ure turugadu pawuduwo Pao iera keje, okudu oiagudu kuricigore kodi, mare pawudui ime ekera kejedu karega.
Icare Davi aidure boe ekogodaeji. Boere tugeragu trigo enariji du kodiwu keje rabodu.
Du kodi Icare Paore ia boe ekogodae pegarewu jetudo Israeldogei, nowu meri piji jii ia kodiboe kae; Icare, Dan piji jii Bersabéia kae, bireboere 7...

Paore ia to tupa arego Jerusalém kae uwo jeta kedodo. Mare kuri je okudugodure nowu boe pega kuricigoredu koia; Icare akore nowu ure boe eeda kedodowu tupaji urugadu! Akera puredu kaba ei pugeje. Pao o tupa rakojere Areuna jebuseu o trigo pa puredu.
Icare Davi, tuiordui nowu tupa rorerui boe ji dukeje, akore oino Pao ji imire iro pegare, ire boe pegarewu towuje. Awu barege kugure rema inoba erore? Akerado boe pegado ii, ioga uwaiji.

Judite oredu iere Manasés, duwu bire boe ji cevada kado dukeje; meri joku urugu ro pegare ji, oebatodui boe ji cevada opodo dutabo. Bire to bakurirewu Betúlia keje; tugududodure mototo tuomage ebo, moto padui Dotain, Balamon, etoiadoda du tada.
Jorure pobe ma jewu metuia bokware pobe puibijidu oiado Judite oredu okware piji dukeje.

Ure ia tumuga pemegado tuwai mugui tumeduia aogejedu keje; nonore ure tugera opodo pudabo, tugarege areme ebo. Ure ia tujebae epa bu tubeagajeje, tugudae corewu ure tugu tugu pudui; otorogare pudui meri jameduji tu tu je tugoadu tonaji; mare sábado keje, ari rutu boe keje, Israeldoge eegarei puduidu boe keje, otorogakare pudui.

Je motu remawu nure, jordu aidugirire boe ji. Oredu Manasesre meriri ekurewu, meriri kigadurewu jetudo apo, ure tudugarege areme, ime, eedudo apo, ure moto maerewu jetudo apo jamedu, du ure inodu padu pemegado pudabo kimo. Iaboe iaboe emago pegakare ji, pagudu kuricigore Paoce kodi.
Nowu du kodi Mardoqueu akore Abraão o Aroe Eimejera, Isaac o Aroe Eimejera, Jacó o Aroe Eimejera, akire boe emago pemegare ai.
Ikimejera, Ikimejera, Boe Eimejera ro rakarewu, boe jamedu boe mugure aro raka kuda, iaboe iaboe emodukare tudugu awadaru kuda, akaidui awo Israeldoge einorudo dukeje.
Are baru, moto, towuje, are baru kudaboe jamedu boe towuje.
Akire akore boe jamedu boece, iaboe iaboe emodukare tudugu aro raka kuda.
Akire aerduware, Ikimejera, ire irugadu iwo inogwa mi Amã bureji, Israeldogewo cinorudo du bogai.
Ikiarire irowo inoduji ikawo ia imedu urugu mugudo arugu bukajeje. Imodukare iejodo iaboe etai, mare akai tu rugadu, Pao Aroe Eimejera.
Icare, Pao Boe Eimejera, Abraão o Aroe Eimejera, akaba boe puredo awobei! Emearudaere tuwo ceeda kedodo, etaidure tuwo boture apijiboe mariguduwu boe eeda kedodo.
Akaba awu awobe eiwo pegado, are etaru Egito piji akaidu.
Awiapagado inogwamagudui ai duji, akerabraredo akaiwugei, ceegare mugudo cegiarigodu mugato. Du keje ceemode cewo akie kurido, Ikimejera, mare akaba okwa jerebarire akabowuge emago bokwado.

Nowu du kodi Brae Eimejerago Ester, tugiarigodu kuricigo tabo, uture Pao ae, okwamagudure oino Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera ji, akore Abraão o Aroe Eimejera, Isaac o Aroe Eimejera, Jacó o Aroe Eimejera, boe emago pemegare ai. Mato, akerabraredo ii, ire ikinoigodu kodi, iaboe iaboekare tuwo tugerabraredo ii apiji, Pao Aroe Eimejera. Imi remawu ire imago boe puredugodui ii du kae. Pao Aroe Eimejera, imearudure, iedagamege eno bapera piji, akie akaidure jiwuge einorudo jii boe oto kae. Du kodi icare, mato, akerabraredo marenaru ii. Bataru moturewu bu inogwa keje, imugumode adugo agarewu jekai dukeje, uwabo tududo tugorigoduwo onare ceiwuji, jeta kedowo tumedage eiamedu apo. Ceginorudo onare ceiwuge ekera piji; ceegareaedo cemarenarudaece, cebemegado ceiwaece.

Nowu meri keje, Ester ure brae eimejeragere tugu puduiwu tugudae pemegarewu tugu pudui, dukeje ure turagojedo brae eimejera mugurewu otodai. Brae eimejera mugure tumuga keje, brae eimejerage ewai tada baiporo jekai. Jordui nowu brae eimejerago jitu keje kuri je, nowu braedu ure uwabodo tugeragu pudui; icare ure boe eimejerage ekedure jiboe meriri ekurewu raido ai, icare Ester ure tuburedo ji, tugera jetuwo ji.
Du keje icare brae eimejera akore oino ji kaboba jiba akogwa magudumode? Kaboba jiba akaidure irowo? Ia dukeje imode ieture jiwu moto kado oiado akai.
Icare Ester akore oino ji Ikimejera, aerdu pemegamode ii dukeje, akaidu keje, iedo: inogwa magudumode jiboe reo; iwobe einorudo: itaidure jiboe reo!

Boewo nono Pao batarure Jeremias ja pijidu. Du kodire Paore Pérsia kejewu brae eimejera Ciro mearudae pemegarewu maku ai, jorui mito brae eimejerai ema dutabo. Du kodire nowu Pérsia kejewu brae eimejera Ciro ure bapera atugodo mugure to moto kejewuge eiamedu boe etai, tagoi oino dutabo oinore Pérsia kejewuge eimejera Ciro akore Aroe Eimejera baru tadawu ure boe epadui pumekejewu boe makuinai; akore iiagu ia tuwai towuje Jerusalém bakurirewu keje, Judá moto keje.
Kakoduwu tagiba taeonare nowu boe ji? Eno Aroe Eimejera muguwo tagabo. Tarududo toro Jerusalém kae, tawo Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera uwai towuje.
Boe eedure Judá keje kimowuge ebo, emode tugera braredo, meriri ekurewu, meriri kigadurewu tabo, tuge tabo, tuguiee tabo, taidure jiboe tabo, Pao mugure Jerusalém kejewu uwaice.
Du keje icare Judá uwobe eimejerage, Benjamim uwobe eimejerage, Pao o burejoiage, levitadoge, aidure Pao jiwuge eiamedu boe, ere turagojedo tuwo Pao uwai towuje, Jerusalém keje.
Mugu puredure eiwuge ere turoiware taboboe jamedu boe maku etai: meriri kigadure, meriri ekurewu, boe eke, boe eeguiee, boe enoroe mori kuricigorewu; iage ere tumagu taidu tabo jamedu.

Nowu kodi, brae eimejera Dário ure bapera atugodo brae eimejerage eedui Eufrates okwa bakowu kejewuge etai, tagoi oino dutabo boe emaragodui Aroe Eimejera uwai jiwuge emaragodu rugadu. Judeudoge eimejerage, codureuge ewo nowu bai towuje tumuga keje.

Ire bapera atugodo Taromodedu tabo, nowu codureuge etai ewo Aroe Eimejera uwai pemegado. Nowu pobo okwa bakowu kejewuge emode nuwu brae eimejera aiboe maku nowu maragodureuge etai, enoe, eke boe morice, ekawo tumaragodaedo tuwuredo.
Brae eimejera Dariore imi imagore oino, tarowo oino rugadu.

Nowu codurewu judeudoge emaragodure taidu tabo, profeta Ageu bataru rekodaji. Zacarias, Ido onaregedu bataru rekodaji jamedu; ere towujedu akedudo, Pao Israeldoge Eno Aroe Eimejera aidu rekodaji. Círio, Dário, Artaxerxes, Pérsia kejewu brae eimejerage etaidu rekodaji jamedu.
Emaragodure nowu Pao uwaiji jii, Adar o ari kejewu meri pobe ma jewu metuia bokware du kae, jorui ikera awubodure mito taci ikera awubowuto, brae eimejerai Dário cedu tabo.
Du keje icare, judeudoge, Pao burejoiage, levitadoge, ia aregodure nonowu ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwuge, ere tuiegaredo nowu Pao uwai todu akedure duji.

Ere tapiradoge ekodure maiwuge emagaguragado, ere carneirodoge emagaguragado, ere maku Pao ai, ere cabritodoge ei ikera pudogidure pobe taci iwure awubowutodu maku Israeldoge eiamedu boe eparu tabo, epadui pumekejedu reore.
Ere sacerdotedoge, levitadoge eedudo tu tu tumaragodae boe keje, emaragoduwo Pao ai Jerusalém keje, padu magai Moisés o bapera kejedu reore.
Aregodure ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwuge ere Páscoa towuje inodu rekodaji, boetojiwu ari kejewu merire ikera pudogidure buture iwure awubowuto pobe puibijiwu keje.

Levitadoge eiamedu boe ere tubemegado, du kodire eiamedu boe ewabo pemegare: ere Páscoa jiwu cordeirodoge ewido, aregodure ia moto tuginoiwu pijiwuge etai, tumanamage Pao burejoiage etai, tuiamedu boe etai.
Meri rekodu tabo, boe ji tomea maku Pao ai dukeje, Esdras imi, ire ikiarigodu barigu ipiji, ikudae mega megai iiogi dutabo, iwudure ipojô tabo, ire ikera aogado Ioga Aroe Eimejera bogai.
Inagore oino ji ino Aroe Eimejera, ipogurure, imorora amagadure ii ie aogado awogai dukeje. Paga karega, cero pegarewu itodure cedaogeje kodi; cero pegarewu kuricigoredu aregodure baruto.

Ia boe ero pegarewu motudu nure cedaogeje jii ceomage epiji jii awu meri kae. Cero pega koiare, cegi, cegimejerage, ceno Pao burejoiage, cemagudure ia moto tuginoiwu kejewu brae eimejerage ekera kai, cemagudure toriga rairewu kai, boe erorerui ceidu kai, iwogu kigodureuge etai, cebogurae mugui cewugeje jii awu meri kaedu kai.

Oino, biega tu je, ceno Aroe Eimejera ure ceomage ekobo cegi ceragoje kimodo, ure cedo cemugudo tumuga pemegarewu keje. Oinore Pao aroe Eimejera aidure ceerduwo turuguji, tui ceragoje kimodo dutabo, boe erorerui ceidu oiado.

U! Boe jokodu, boe erorerure jiwugere cegi, mare ceno Aroe Eimejera ukare tugera ra cebiji, boe erorerui ceidu tonaji; dure karega, ure Pérsia kejewuge eimejerado turo pemegado cei, ure ceragoje kimodo cewo ceno Aroe Eimejera uwai pemegado, cewo cegera pemegado pegadodureboeji; ure ia ceeda pemegado Judá keje.
Nowu du kodi, Davire Israeldoge eiamedu boe eto pui Jerusalém keje ewo Pao o irá pemegarewu taru ture pemegadowu muga kae.
Davi makore Arão rekodajiwuge ewogai, Levitadoge ewogai jamedu.
Levi ore ere Pao o irá pemegarewu aogado tui o iwara bu tuganaora keje dutabo, Moisés akore Pao bataru rekodajidu reore.

Davi makore Levitadoge eimejeragei eiagu uwiemage eonado turagodu turagoduwo, boe ekera enogwa akore jiboe tabo, harpadoge, citaradoge ka boe tabo, ewo tugera ako, togwa ako rakaguragado, tuiegare koia.
Tui Pao o irá pemegarewu remo dutabo, ere mugudo Divire pemegado bogaiwu aroia bai oiadoda. Ere tomea boe ku bokwarewu maku.
Nowu ei tomea boe ku bokwarewu maku durekodaji, Davire togwamu boe eiogi Pao ie tabo.

Nowu du kodi boe eimejera Salomão, Israeldoge eiamedu boe ei tudo pui apodu, Pao o irá pemegarewu jekai, ere tomea barege kugure, tapiradoge, emagaguragado, du kodire boe eerduwakare kaiba enodo padure.

Pao burejoiagere nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu reko tumuga kae Pao uwai pemegarewu remawu tada, tupadoge eigodo kuda; tupadoge ere cigodo jado nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu joki, o iwaradoge ei pobedu joki jamedu.
Nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu mugure nono jii awu meri kae.

Iaboe iaboe metukare nowu irá pemegarewu tada, mare tu boe eroiagudu padure kejewu tori boarewu ui pobedu, Moisesre mugudo tadawu, Paoi tuwadaru maku Israeldoge etai dukeje, ei tudawuje Egito pijidu kejewu, mugure tada.
Kuri je, tumagai mito tu je du reore, meriri iworewu epage, urareuge, ere tudo mito tu je tuiaruru tabo, tuiegarei Pao jitu tabo.
Meriri iworewu, ka boe, boe ekera akore jiboe boe, boe enogwa akore jiboe boe ego utonaji, boe emearudure boe egoi Pao jituji pemegaguragare kodi, okudu oiagudure boe ebo jii je kodi.
Nowu Pao uwai korobadure boetugu corewu tabo, du kodire Pao burejoiage eroiwakare tumaragodaeji.
Paore tuwai korobadudo turugu tabo kodi.
Du kodi icare Salomão akore Pao aidure tumuguwo boe eerdukare pudui boe tada, mare ire awai towuje, amuguwo tada jii je.
Joiada bi rekodaji, nowu Judá kejewuge eimejerage etaregodure tuwo tubujodo nowu brae eimejera kurirewu Joasji.
Nowu brae eimejera kurirewu ure tuwiapagado ei.
Du tabore icare ere tugera ra tuomage eno Aroe Eimejera uwai piji, ere tubujodo Aroe Eimejerakare emaboe ji; ere Pao korigo Judá kejewugei, Jerusalém kejewugei, awu ero pegarewu koia.
Paore profetadoge emagodo ei ewo tugirimi Aroe Eimejera ae, mare ewiapagakare egoi pudui duji.

Du kodi icare Pao Utaroere turemo Zacaria, Pao burejoia Joiada onaregeduto, dure icare uture boe etae, akore ei oinore Pao akore Kodiba tawiapagakare Paoi boe eroiaguduji, du kodi icare boe pemegakare tai pugeje? Tare tagera ra Pao piji, du kodire ure tugera ra tabiji jamedu!
Du kodi icare. Ere taogado jokorai, brae eimejera kurirewu ure edo bito tori tabo.
Brae eimejera kurirewu Joás biagodure tuo Joiada roi pudai dupiji, ure onaregedu bito, dure akore oino tuwi tabo Pao umode tugogado awu inoduji.

Du tabore icare, nowu jorui mitodu akedu keje, Arameia kejewu tugobaigarege eture Joás togi, ere turemo Judá mototo, Jerusalém bakurireuto, ere boe imejerage eiamedu boe eeda kedodo, ere boe enoroe jamedu boe maku Damasco kejewu brae eimejera ai.
Aram o tugobaigarege emagagirikare mare Paore ia tugobaigarege emagaguragareuge emagu ai, awuge ere tugera ra tuomage eno Aroe Eimejera piji kodi. Oinore ere tugogado Joasji.

Eture piji tui kuridodu kuricigodo dutabo; dukeje icare utugarege emago pegare ji, ure Joiada onaregedu bito dukoia, icare ere bito tuba keje. Oinore bire, ere tugu Davi bakurirewu keje, mare brae eimejerage kurireuge emedu emedure tadawu tada karega.
Nowu du kodi, Pao burejoiage eimejerage, boe eiamedu boe ere turo pega kuricigodo. Ere turodo nono kruca padukare kejewuge ero reore. Ewiapagakare turoi Pao uwai todui Jerusalém keje duji.
Mare etuomage eno Aroe Eimejera ure boe erojai tu tu ewogai, okudure tuwobe ebo, tuwai pemegarewu apo, kodi.
Mare ere tuwadaru kedaedo Paore rojaiwugei, ewiapagakare ewadaruji, ere togwari omeado profetadogei.
Du kodi icare Pao korigodui tuwobe eidu oto padukare.

Du kodi icare onare eiwuge ere joru tugu Pao uwaito, ere aiare Jerusalém tabowu moto ri rugadu butudo, ere joru tugu Jerusalém kejewu bai kurireuge eiamedu boeto, ere enoroe mori kuricigorewu rugadu pegado.

Nowu inodu rekodaji, brae eimejera Nabucodonosor ure rakoje kimoreuge eiamedu boe erego Babilônia kae, du kodi icare ere Nabucodonosor utugaregedo pudumi, ere nowu brae eimejera ore etugaregedo pudumi jamedu, jii Persa kejewuge eimejera jeture nowu moto jiboe kae.
Oinore boe kodure Pao akoi Jeremias ja pijidu reore. Motore tamudo boe erorerui ei du tonaji jii jorure 70 cedu kae.
Du keje icare, Persa kejewuge eimejerai Ciro cedu boetojiwu joru keje, Paore brae eimejera Ciro roto nono tuwadaru aregodui Jeremias ja pijidu reore.

Cirore boedo boe awadudo to moto kejewuge eiamedu boe etai, tuwadaru tabo, bapera atugo tabo, tagoi oino dutabo oinore Persa kejewu brae eimejera Ciro akore Pao baru tadawu ure moto jamedu boe mugudo ikera keje. Ure ido ia tuwai to Jerusalém, Judá kejewu bakurirewu, keje. Jeonare awu boe eiboe, tadudo toro, tago Aroe Eimejera muguwo tagabo.

Ure tugogado boeiwuge eeture boe ei du kodiwu keje, boe eke boi buture nowu moto keje, dukeje Icare ia Judá o moto kejewu bakurirewu iei Belém cedu kejewu ia imedu uture toreduje apo, tore kugurei pobe tu jedu apo, tumugu koboriwo Moab o moto keje.
Imedu iere Elimelec, oredu iere Noemi, ore ei pobedu ekiere Maalon masre Quelion.
Du keje Icare Elimelec, Noemi oredu, bire, emare rakojere tuginoigodu tore kugure ebo.
Awuge ere tugera maku Moab kejewu areme etai, duwuge ia iere Orfa, metuia iere Rute. Eedure nono jorui ikera pudogidu reore.
Du keje, nowu ime ei pobedu, Maclon mare Quilion, ewire jamedu. Du kodi Icare nowu aredu rakojere tore bokwa tabo, tugoge bokwa tabo.
Du kodi Icare cewu aredu ure turagojedo turagomage ei pobedu apo, tuwo tugirimi Moab moto piji pugeje; paga karega, mearudure boe egoi Paoi tugududo tuwobe ebo, tui amirewu maku etai dutabo duji.
Icare etoragudure pugeje. Du kodi Icare Orfare togwabi tujarugoji, ure tugirimi tuwobe etae pugeje, mare Rute ukare tugera ra piji.
Du kodi Icare Noemi akore oino ji icare amedagore tugirimi tuwobe ewogai, to Aroe Eimejera bogai. Aki jamedu akirimi apo jamedu.

Mare Rute akore oino ji akao tugudu kaba ii, iwo ikera ra apiji, iwo iiaedo apiji, mare akodumodewo kae ikodumode jamedu; amode amugudowo keje, imode imugudo keje jamedu; iwobe nure awobece, ino Aroe Eimejera nure ako Aroe Eimejerace jamedu.
Oinore Noemire tugirimi Moab moto piji, turago Moab kejewudo Rute apo. Etaregodure Belém kae, boere tugera tugu cevada a jitu kae.
Noemi uwobere ia toredu uwobece, imedu oe kuricigorewu, Elimelec uwobe, iere Booz.
Rute moabita akore oino Noemi ji itudo boepato iwo ikeragu ia trigo imodoji, jewu imedu aidumode iiwu rekodaji. Noemi akore oino ji toro, itonaregedu!
Uture boepato, ure tugeragu trigo imodoji ure trigo kadowuge ekera rekodaji, dure jiwo aidugirire nowu Booz o boepa kejegodu radu ure tugeragu nowu trigo imodoji, cewu Elimelec uwobe.

Du kodi Icare Elimelec akore oino Ruteji. Awiapagado, itonaregedu, akaba akeragu trigo imodoji ia toro, mare woe tu rugadu; akaba aiaedo awu piji, mare amedagedo itugarege aremece. Akaiwodo kakoduwu boepa kejeba emode trigo kado, ako eregodaji. Imagore itugaregei emago kawo ai. Pobo boimode ai ma, aku itugarege ere tawuje motoia pijiwu mugure epowari tadawu poboce.
Du kodi Icare Rute ure tubujodo tui tuie jodo mototo, dutabo akore ji kaiba iwo aidugirire awiapagawo ii? Kode, ia moto tuginoiwu kejewudo nure imi.
Booz akore oino ji boe ereadodure kobori kobori iwiagai arore acarugo jituji akoredu bi rekodaji, are akera ra ao piji, ace piji, ako moto piji, amuguwo ia aerduwakare jiwu boe etada.
Du kodi Icare Boozre Rute mugudo pudabo, ure tugera maku ai, mugure apo, du kodi Icare, Pao aidu rekodaji, kuiarure, kuri buture ia tonaregedu apo.

Du kodi Icare areme egore oino Noemi biagai boewo Pao akaru kurido, ukare ia aregodajiwu bokwado! Ie uwo tumaedo Israeloge etada, ierabrarewo ai apegagodu keje; paga karega, boture arago piji, dure pemegare ai akore emode ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto du kori.
Du kodi Icare Noemire tugeragu negeduroguji, ure bu tugana keje, jeture ji uce mugato.
Mugu puredure jiwu metage egore Noemi negedurogu boture! Ure iedo Obed. Dure Jessé uo rema. Davi uore Jessece.
Nowu kodi, Israeldoge ere Pao aidukare jiboe towuje, ere tubujodo Baaldogei.
Ere tuboru barigu tuomage eno Aroe Eimejera ji, ure etawuje Egito pijidu, ekodure ia aroe eimejerage tuginoiwuge eregodaji, mugu puredure puduiwuge eno aroe eimejeragei, dutabo ere Pao korigo.
Ere tuiaedo Pao ji tuwo tubujodo Baal ji, Astartedogei.

Du kodi Icare Pao korigodu kuricigore Israeldogei, ure emagu roarodureuge ekera kai, duwugere tugeragu enoe boeji; ure emagu mugu puredure eiwu onare eiwuge etai, du kodire Icare eroiwakare tuwo turodo ia turo onare puduiwugei.
Erore ia turo dukeje, Pao iera motudure ewugeje, turo pegai ei dutabo, ture tuwadaru maku ei du reore, ure emorora amagadudodu rakaguragado pudui.
Paore ia ure tugogado boeiwuge emagu emagu etai, duwuge ere einoru einorudo rorerure eiwuge epiji.

Mare boe ewiapagakare nowu ure tugogado boeiwuge ewadaruji jamedu; ere tumagu pagapagawu aroe eimejerage tuginoiwugei, ere tubujodo ei. Kuri je ere tuiaedo tuomage ekodure jiwu awara piji, duwugere emearutorure Pao o boe eroiaguduji, emagerema erokare ino.

Paore ia ure tugogado boeiwu maku etai dukeje, turagojei apo du tonaji, ure einoru einorudo onare eiwuge erorerui ei dupiji, nowu ure tugogado boeiwu rakoje kimo tabo. Pao okudure akoi toragudu tabo duji, onare eiwuge erorerui eiwuge eigoia.

Mare nowu ure tugogado boeiwu okwa rekodaji, ere turo pega jagudo tuomage ekori, tudui aroe eimejerage pagapagareuge eregodaji tuwo tubujodo ji, ekare tugera ra ia turo pegarewu piji, du kodire ero pega kowodure.
Nowu dukeje, Pao o tupare turawuje, ure tumugudo Ofra kejewu terebinto i paru, Joas, Abiezer uwobe o moto keje, onaregedu Gedeão ui trigo to boeji, tuwo biado madianitadoge epiji du tonaji.
Nowu Pao o tupa aregodure ai, dutabo akore oino ji Pao muguwo akabo, tugobaigare ro rakarewu!

Icare Gedeão akore oino Ikimejera, inogwa magudumode ai: amugure cedabo ma, kodiba boere oino cei? Boe ero rakarewu towujedure paomage eegaiwu pa? Oinore egore cewiagai 'Paore cedawuje Egito piji'. Macare oino Paore tuiaedo cei, ure cemagu madianitadoge ekera kai.
Mare Paore tuie kirimi ae, akore oino ji toro, nowu aduru tabo, amode Israeldoge einorudo madianitadoge erorerui ei dupiji. Imi karega ire atudo atudo toro?
Gedeão akore Ikimejera, inoba imode Israeldoge einorudo? Iwobe ewiega remawure Manasés uwobe etada, imire ikodure boigodu ioga uwai keje.
Pao akore oino ji iragojemode akabo, amode amorido madianitadogei emagai imedui mito tu je du reore.
Gedeão akore aerdu pemegai ii dukeje, akaidumode awo ido boe pa ia aro jitu keje, inogwa magudumode ai atukawo awu piji jii imode ikirimi ia ino mea tabo akai.
Pao akore u! Iragojemode jii woe, ai akirimidu kae.
Gedeão uture, ure tugera pemegado ia cabritoji, ure ia amirewu towuje ia trigo kudu tabo; ure kodureboe tugu ia kodoraboto, ure kuru tugu ia ariato, ure reko toro 'carvalho' i paru kae, ure makuai.
Icare Pao o tupa akore oino ji akeragu kodureboeji, amireuji, mugudo awu tori aogeje, kuru redo.
Gedeão mearutorure bataruji.

Du kodi Icare Pao o tupare nowu ure arego tugedui ji tu tabowu iwara aogado, ure oto jetudo nowu kodureboeji, nowu amireuji. Kuri je, joru aregodure nowu tori piji, dure ure nowu kodureboe, nowu amirewu rugadu akedudo, Icare Pao o tupa okware pi tuku joku piji.
Du kodi Icare Gedeãore boe pa Pao Aroe Eimejera o tupa iure ema duji, Icare akore iui! Ikimejera Aroe Eimejera, iordure ako tupaji ioku awadu tabo!
Mare Pao akore oino ji boe butugurewu muguwo akabo! Apagudu kaba! Awimoduka!
Icare Gedeão ure ia tori bu pu aogeje nono, ure iedo oino Pao ro butugurewu.
Nowu du kodi, Siquém kejewuge eiamedu boe, Bet-Melo kejewuge eiamedu boe, ere tudo pui, ere tugimejerado Abimelecce, puredu tu Siquém kejewu tori mugui paru kejeu 'carvalho' iji.
Boe ereadodui nowu inoduji Joatão biagai dukeje, awu ruture torekari Garizim ao kae, makore etai toiogwari tabo tawiapagado ii, Siquém kejewu boe, Pao mearuduwo tai!
Ia boe keje itura boe etaidure tuwo tugimejerado ia iji pudai. Du kodi Icare egore oino 'oliva' iji: 'Cegimerado aki cenai! '
'Oliva' i akore oino ei 'Imodukana ikera ra boekaguru boture ipijiwu, dutabo boere Pao kurido, ime ekurido, dupiji, iwo imugudo iguru boe ewugeje? '
Du keje Icare iguru boe egore oino figueiraji 'Mato, awo cegimejerado aki cenai'.
Akore oino ei 'Imodukana ikera ra iwedu piji, itudu rorewu piji, iwo imugudo iguru boe ewugeje? '
Du keje Icare iguru boe egore oino 'parera' ikuji: 'Mato, cegimejerawo aki du bogai! '
Mare nowu 'parera' iku akore oino ei 'Imodukana ikera ra ure Pao, ime eegaredowu ikuru piji, iwo imugudo itura boe ewugeje? '
Du kodi Icare iguru boe eiamedu boe egore oino boto ikuji 'Mato, awo cegimejerado aki cenai! '

Icare nowu boto iku akore nowu iguru boe ji 'Tagaidumode tagimejerawo imi rugadu ma, mato, tagamudo itugu kuda; mare tagaidukare dukeje, joru aregodumode botoguru piji tuwo Líbano kejewu nowakodu iguru rugadu kowuje'.
Nowu du kodi, Pao utaroere turaweje Jefté keje, dure kodure Galaad Manasés eno moto kajeje, Galaad kejewu Mispa kori, aregodure amonitadoge eno moto kae.

Jeftere tuwadaru maku Pao ai, tagoi oino dutabo amode amonitadoge emagu ikera kai ma, cewu utumode iwai poro piji itogiwu, ii ikirimi boe puredukai ii amonitadoge epiji dukeje, emare Pao Aroe Eimejera o mode ema, imode inomeado apo Pao ai:
Jefté uture amonitadoge etogi turugoduwo ei, dukeje Icare Paore emagu iera kai.
Ure tumorido ei jii Aroer piji jii Menit kae, bakurireuge ere ikera awubodure iwure awubodure, jii Abel-Carmim kae, tui ewidodu kuricigodo. Du kodire icare Israeldoge ere tumorido amonitadogei.
Jefté, ui tugirimi Mispa kejewu tuwai kae dukeje, onaregedu aredu uture togi tureru tabo. Onaregedu ui mito tu jedu, ia bokware piji.
Tuiordui jitu keje, ure tugudae bowuje toiogwari tabo ié! Itonaregedu, are iwo pegado! Aigoiare are imorora amagadudo ii, paga karega. Ire iwadaru maku Pao ai, iroiwakare iwo iwadaru kirimi tuibagi.
Emare akore oino ji ioga, are awadaru maku Pao ai dukeje, arodo ii aiabijiboe rekodaji, Paore tumorido onare aiwuge Amon orei akera tabo kodi.
Du keje okwamagudure tuoji inogwa magudumode ai: imedage eko itabo torekaridoge etao kao, arimode pobe, itoragoduwo ikodui mai duji.
Akore oino ji toro! Icare ure utudo ari pobe dutabo. Kodure tumedage ebo torekaridoge etao kao, toragodui tugodui mai duji.
Arii pobedu akedu keje, ure tugirimi tuo uwai kae, dure ure tuwadaru maku Pao aidu towuje ji.
Nowu meri keje, ia Saraá kejewu ia imedure, Dan uwobe, iere Manué, oreduje ore bokware.
Pao o tupa ure tawadudo nowu aredu ai, akore ji icare ore bokwareudo nure aki, mare akuiarumode, akuributumode ia akonaregedu apo.

Du kodi Icare akodu kaba parera kuruce, ia kuru korirewu boece, akaba ia ake pegarewu kowuje; paga karega, akuiarumode, ia akonaregedu botumode, dure ia meriri o micigirewu umodukare ao kado; paga karega, nowu negedurogu makudumode Pao ai tuwodu otodai, umode Israeldoge etaru filisteodoge ekera piji.

Icare nowu aredu ure toredu biie tagoi oino dutabo ia Pao apowu imedu aregodure iwogai, ure nono Pao o tupare, pemegaguragare. Inoragodukare ji kaiba kejewu ure ema duji, ukare iwie tugieji jamedu. Akore oino ii 'Akuiarumode, akuri butumode ia akonaregedu apo. Du kode, akudu kaba parera kuruce, ia kuru korireboe boece, akaba ia boe pegarewu ko; paga karega, nowu negedu rogu makudumode Pao ai botumodedu otodai jii tuwi kae.
Icare nowu aredu kuri buture ia tonaregedu apo, dure ure iedo Sansão. Nowu negedurogu ricodure, Paore jiwo pemegado.
Pao utaroere tawadudo keje, Dan moto keje.

Nowu du kodi Pao akore oino Josueji awu piji, imode akurido Israeldoge eegai, ewo boe pa iragojei akabo, iragoje magai Moisés apo du reore duji. Aki amode Sacerdotedogedo boe eroiagudu mugure kejewu irá reko, akagoi ei oino dutabo: 'Tagaregodui Jordão po okwato dukeje, tawuredo nono'.
Icare Josué akore oino Israeldogei taburedo, tamearududo Tago Aroe Eimejera Bataruji.
Du kejere akore oino pugeje oinore taerdumode Pao jerewu rakojei tadoda duji: umode Canaã kejewuge ewarigu tagoda piji.
Icá, Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure tadawu ira umode pagado Jordão kajeje tagododai.
Ure Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure tadawu irá rekowu sacerdotedoge emode tuwure tugu Jordão poto dukeje, pobo umode tugado puiato; aregodure cobugiwu pobo umode tuwuredo tui tudo pui dutabo.
Dure karega, ere turagojedo tuwo pagado Jordão po kajeje dukeje, sacerdotedogere tugo etododai.

Ure Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure kejewu irá rekowuge etaregodui Jordão po okwai dukeje, ewure pegoi pobo okwa keje dukeje (Jordão pore tumaedo togwa jamedu joki ere toe boe kado jiboe keje), pobore tuwuredo.
Aregodure cobugiboe pijiwu pobo ure tuwuredo, ure tudo puidu raicigore, Adam bakurirewu piji jii bakurirewu moto ri padure porugajejewu iei Sartã cedu kae.
Ure turawuje pobo maerewu Sal meture kejewu towu pobo akedure pi tuku je.
Icare nowu boe ere pagado Jericó bakurirewu otodai.

Ure Pao o boe eroiagudu mugure tadawu irá rekowu sacerdotedoge ere tuwuredo turagoje tabo Jordão po kidu reia keje, Israeldoge eiamedu boe ei pagado tuwure kidu tabodu tonaji. Eedure nono jii boe eiamedu boe ei pagado du kae.
Nowu du kodi Pao akore oino Josueji awuji ire Egito kejewu boe erorerae barigu tabiji.
Israeldogere baado Gálgala keje, Nonore Icare, meri rekodu tabo, ere Páscoa towuje, ari kejewu merire ikera pudogidure buture iwure awubowuto pobe puibiji dukeje, Jericó boe boarewu keje.
Páscoa rekodajiwu meri keje, ere nowu moto kejeboe kowuje: amirewu bari bari, trigo goridodu tabo.
Rekodajiwu meri keje, enogwagei nowu moto kejeboe rekodaji, cewu 'maná' butukare pugeje Israeldoge etai; nowu joru piji, enogwagere Canaã moto kejeboeji.
Nowu du kodi, Josuere ia altar towuje Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera ai, Ebal boe aoporu aogeje, Pao utugare Moisés akoi Israeldogei durekodaji, padu magai Moisés o bapera atugo keje.
Nowu altar keje, ure to mea maku Pao Aroe Eimejera ai ro pemegarewu jipagi.
Nonore Icare Josuére Moisés o boe eroiagudu atugodo ia tori keje, Israel ore eegai.

Israeldoge eiamedu boe, codureuge, tugobaigarege, boe jetororewu epage eragojere nowu Pao o irá pemegarewu jeke keje puibiji, Pao burejoiage eegai, levitadoge eegai, duwugere enoredure Pao o irá pemegarewu tabo.

Ia moto tuginoiwu kejewuge eragojere nono Israeldoge ebo; iage eragojere taiwo tabo Gerizim aoporu jaogwai, iage eragojere taiwo tabo Ebal aoporu jaogwai, oinore Pao utugare Moisés akore boe eroiagu, tuwo togwami boe eiogi.
Nowu inodu rekodaji Josué makore nowu boe eroiagudu padui bapera kejedu jamedu boeji, boe eiwo pemegareuji, boe eiwo pegareuji, padu magai nowu mugure bapera kejewu boe eroiagudu kejedu reore.
Josué makore Moisés ui boe eroiagudu jamedu boeji Israeldoge eiamedu boe ewiagai, areme, boe etore, moto tuginoiwu kejewuge eragojere nono ebodu ewiegai jamedu.
Nowu dukeje, Josuere Israel uwobe epadui pumekejedu eto pui Siquém keje, makore codureuge, boe eimejerage, ure tugogado boeiwuge, aiwore boeiwuge, ewogai, duwugere etaregodure Pao jekae.

Icare Josué akore boe eiamedu boe ji oinore Pao Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera akore taomagere, Abrão Nakormage etuo iei Taré cedu reore, eedure marigudu pobo okwa bakowu keje, ere tubujodo ia aroe eimejeragei.
Mare ire tao Abraão tawuje pobo okwa bakowu piji, ire reko Canaã kejewu moto jamedu boe kajeje, ire rekodajiwuge emagaguragado.
Ire Isaac maku ai, ire Jacó mare Esaú maku Isaac ai. Ire Seir torekari maku Esaú ai, Jacoi turawuje Egito kae tore ebo du tonaji.
Du keje Icare ire Moisés Aarão mage erojai, ire Egito kejewuge etogorido, iro rakarewu tuginoiwu boe tabo. Ire tado tadawuje nowu moto piji.
Mare taomage etaregodui pobo maerewu okwa kae dukeje, Egito kejewuge eregodure eregodaji to imarido boe tabo, kowarudoge ewugejewuge ebo, jii Pobo Kujagu maerewu kae.
Emagore iwogai ire taedudo Egito kejewuge epiji, ii boetugu mugudo tagoiadoda dutabo. Ire pobo maerewu barigu eiogi, dure ure ekowuje.
Taerdure taeku tabo iroi Egito keje duji, durekodaji tamugu raicigore boe makodu tada.
Ire tarego amorreudoge emugui Jordão bakowu kejedu eno moto kae. Erugodure tai, mare ire emagu tagera kai, tare tamugudo eno moto keje, ire eeda kedodo tagododai.
Moab kejewuge eimejera Balac, Sefor onaregedu, ure turagojedo jamedu, rugodure Israeldogei, makore Beor naregedu Balaão bogai uwo eiwo pegado du bogai.
Mare imi itaidukare iwiapagawo bataruji, du kodire Icare ure tuwadaru pemegarewu bu tawugeje, ire taginorudo iera piji.

Tai tawu Jordão kajeje dukeje, tagaregodui Jericó kae dukeje, nowu bakurirewu kejewuge erugodure tai, durekodaji, amorreudoge, ferezeudoge, cananeudoge, hititadoge, gergeseudoge, heveudoge, jebuseudoge, erugodure tai jamedu, mare ire emagu tagera kai.
Ire atuge etudo tagododai duwugere tuiodo nowu boe ewugeje tabiji, amorreudoge eimejerage ei pobedu ewugeje jamedu, tago tariga rairewu bokwa tabo, tawaiga bokwa tabo.
Oinore ire tamaragodukare jiwu moto maku tagai, ire tamugudo takare towujewu bakurireuge etada, tagogwagere takare tuguwu parera iguru kurodu boeji, oliveira iguru kurodu boeji.

Nowu kodi, Josué akore boe eiamedu boe ji tabagududo Paoce, tawiapagado ji tawabo pemegarewu jetororewu tabo. Taomage ewiapagare jiwu pobo bakowu keje, Egito keje, aroe eimejerage pagapagawuge ewarigu tabiji, tawiapagado tu Pao ji.

Mare taerdu pegamode tawiapagawo Pao ji ma, tawiapagado toro iage ewogai awuji; taomage ewiapagare jiwu pobo okwa bakowu kejewuge ewogai rakudu, iarema amorreudoge eno aroe eimejerage ewogai, duwuge eno moto keje taedure. Imirema, iwobe ebo, cewiapagamode Pao Aroe Eimejera ji.

Icare boe egore cemearudaei cewo cegera ra Pao pijidu, mugu jaedo cebiji; mare Aroe Eimejerare pago Aroe Eimejera rema; ure cegi, ceomage cedawuje Egito moto piji, boe erorerui cei dupiji; ure turo kurirewu towuje ceegai, aiwore cegodure kejewu awara jamedu boe keje, cegodui boe eiamedu boe ekori dutabo.
Paore boe epadui pumekejewu boe eiamedu boe ewarigu cegoda piji, mugure awu moto kejewu amorreudoge jamedu.
Du kodi Icare, cegi jamedu cewiapagamode Pao ji, ceno Aroe Eimejera nure ema kodi.
Josué akore oino boe ji taroiwa modukare tawiapagawo Pao ji; paga karega, Aroe Eimejera pemegarewu nure ema, joku iru barikare kodi. Umodukare tu je, tai taboru barigu ji taro pegarewu tabo.
Tamode tagera ra Pao piji ma, tawiapagamode ia aroe eimejerage pagapagawuge ei ma, umode tugirimi tuibagi, Icare, ro pemegai tai durekodaji, ro pegamode tai, umode taeda kedodo.
Mare boe egore oino Josueji boro! Cewiapagamode Pao ji!
Josué akore oino boe ji tamearudure pu akoinoduji, tai tageragu Pao ji, tawiapagawo tu ji.
Egore cewiapagare pu akoino duji.
Icare Josué akore kode, aroe eimejerage tuginoiwuge ewarigu tabiji, tawabodo tuiekirimi Pao Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera ji.
Boe egore oino Josueji cewiapagamode ceno Aroe Eimejera ji, ceromode nono bataru rekodaji.
Oinore nowu meri keje, Josuere tuwadaru maku tuwobe etai Siquém keje, tui boe eroiagudu maku etai dutabo.
Ure nowu inodu jamedu bu Pao o boe eroiagudu padure kejewu bapera keje. Du kejere, ure tugeragu ia tori kurireuji, ure rakojedo nono, mugure makudure Pao aiwu moto kejewu carvalho i kuda.

Icare makore oino boe eiamedu boe ji awu tori mugumode woe pamagai pawadaru maku puai du reore; paga karega, mearudure Pao akoi paidu jamedu boeji. Emare okituwamode tai, takawo tagera ra Pao Aroe Eimejera piji.
Du rekodaji Josué imadure boe ji, eture tu tu tumugurewo boe kae.
Nowu inodu rekodaji, Josué, Nun onaregedu, Pao utugare, bire to jorui 1 0 cedu keje.
Paoi tuiagu Elias reko ia managadodu tabo baruto dukeje, Elias uture Galgala piji, Eliseu apo.

Etaregodui Jericó kae dukeje, Elias akore oino Eliseu ji aragojedo tu woe, Pao nure itudo Jordão kae kodi. Mare Eliseu akore oino aroe Eimejera koia, akaroe koia, imodukare iwuredo apiji. Du kodi Icare, ei pobedu, eture.
Ia etugarege ei 50 cedu, ekodure jamedu ere tuburedo eegai, eedui Jordão okwa bakowu keje dutabo.
Du keje icare Eliare tugeragu tugudae aogejewu, ure oreado, ure to poboji, ure toiado pubiji, dutabore ei pobedu ere pagado tuwure tabo moto kiji.
Ere pagado bakowuto dukeje, Elias akore oino Eliseu ji akogwamagududo ii akaidure jiboe bogai, iregodudodumode apiji duotodai. Eliseu akore oino itaroedo akaroe reore pobe.
Elias akore akogwamagudure ii boe biarewu bogai. Mare iregodudodumode apiji, aerdumode ii dukeje, makudumode akai. Aerdumodukare ii dukeje, makudu modukare akai.
Ekodure awaraji tumagoi pui dutabore Icare ia jorui nono imarido cedu reoredu, kawarudogei tumugudo kejedu, ure ewarigu pubiji, Icare Elias ruture baruto ia managadodu tada.
Eliseu aiwore rekodaji toiogwari tabo ioga, ioga! Israeldoge eno imarido, eegu kawarudoge!
Tuiordukare jitu rekodaji, ure tugeragu tugudaeji, tui tumugudo taci keje, ure bowuje puibiji; durekodaji, ure tugeragu buture Elias pijiwu aroia ogejewuji, ure tugirimi Jordão okwato.
Ure tugeragu nowu buture Elias kanaora pijiwu aroiaji, ure to poboji, tagoi oino dutabo kaiba Elias o Aroe Eimejera rakojere. Ema jamedu, ure to poboji, pobore tugado puiato, Icare Eliseu ure pagado.
Ia meri keje, Eliseu kodure Sunam kori. Ia aredu oroe kuricigoreudo mugure nono, duwudo makore ji okwagewo tuwai keje. Kodu kodui nowu kori dukeje, ure tuwure tuwuredo togwagewo nono.
Nowu aredu akore oino toreduji awu aregodu aregodure woe pawai kaewu imedu ire boe pa Pao bure joia iure ema duji.
Kode, pawo ia bairogu to pawai aogeje, pawo ia kamorewu, ia ira rogu, ia muga ira, ia jorugu bu tada, uwo tamudo tugodui woe pagori dukeje.
Ia meri keje, tugodui ekori dukeje, Eliseu ure turemo nowu bai roguto tuwo tamudo.
Icare akore oino tudugare Gieziji inoba iromode ji? Icare Giezi akore ji ore bokwa, oredu codugodure.
Eliseu akore ji amagodo bogai. Makore bogai. Aregodure baiporo kae.
Eliseu akore oino ji ia joru aregodumode dukeje, ia akonaregedu rogu mugumode akana keje.
Ia meri keje, sunamita onaregedu uture tuo rakojere ure trigo kadowuge ebo du kae.
Akore oino ji ié itaora! Ié itaora! Icare uo akore oino ia tudugareji reko tuje bogai!
Ure tugeragu ji, ure reko uce bogai, duwudo ure mugudo tubogora keje jii meri brae etaiadoda, dukeje bire.
Icare ruture apo ure bu profeta Eliseu pa keje, ure baiporo mi, uture piji.
Icare Elias, taregodui tuwai kae dukeje, jorudure nowu negedurogu biji, padui tuba keje duji.
Ure turemo, ure baiporo mi, pudui, nowu negedurogu apo, Icare okwamagudure Aroe Eimejera ji.
Ruture tuba kae, ure tuwu nowu negedrogu keje, ore togwa bu okwa keje, ure tuioku bu joku keje, ure tugera bu iera keje, tubadui keje dutabo, dutabore nowu negedrogu kodu urugodure.
Du keje Icare merure jice woje jice woje tuwai tada; dukeje Icare ruture pugeje, ure tuwu negedrogu keje. Awure Icare ure tuia barido ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, ure tuioku jado.
Icare Eliseu makore utugare Giezi bogai, akore ji amagodo sunamita bogai. Icare Giezi makore bogai. Aregodui pudae dukeje, Eliseu makore oino ji akeragu akonaregeduji.
Ure turemo, buture bure paru, tuie jodo jii mototo, Icare ure tugeragu tonaregeduji, ure tuiebu.

Nowu du kodi, Baal-Salisa kejewu ia imedu aregodure, unure to boepa pijiboe boetojiwu ui amireudo emadu arego tugodorabo tada Pao utugare Eliseu bogai: trigo maiwu, cevada maiwu amireure ikera pudogidure, iwure pudogidure du reorere.
Eliseu akore oino ji maku boe etai ewo kowuje.
Mare nowu imedu akore oino ji inoba iromode iwo maku umodukai turugadu boe ji dutabo? Eliseu akore ji pemega pugeje.
Maku boe etai ewo kowuje; paga karega, oinore Pao akore emode kowuje, jetumode tuiageje kimo'.
Icare nowu imedu ure pedo boe etai; jeture tuiageje kimo, Pao bataru rekodaji.

Nowu du kodi, Síria kejewu brae eimejera o tugobaigarege eimejera Naaman, boe eerdu pemegare jiwu imedu, ukimejera rokare kara kara ia bataru keje, paga karega, iera tabore Paore Síria kejewuge einorudo. Mare nowu tugobaigarege eimejera ro rakarewu, pagudu bokwarewu, moci baare ji.
Boekarema, ia arameudoge etaregodui Síria pijidu, erade ia Israel pijiwu ia nogwaredu rogu arego pudabo, duwudore maragodure Naaman oreduje ai.
Duwudo akore oino tugimejeragoji uia turugadu ikimejera utuwo Samaria kejewu profeta ae. Ia dukeje umode moci barigu piji.
Icare Naaman readodure inoduji tugimejera brae eimejera biegai, akore ji oinore Israel kejewu nogwaredurogu akore.

Du kodi Icare Síria kejewu brae eimejera akore ji u! Atudo toro. Imode bapera atugodo Israeldoge eimejera bogai. Naaman uture meriri kigadurewu mori kuricigorewu ui tugera pudogidu reore dutabo, meriri ekurewu ui 6. 0 cedu tabo, boe ekudae mori kuricigorewu ui ikera pudogidure dutabo.
Ure bapera atugo maku Israeldoge eimejera ai, akoi oino dutabo ire itugare Naaman utudo awogai awu bapera atugo tabo, awo moci barigu piji.

Israeldoge eimejera, tumagoi nowu bapera jitu keje, ure tugudae bowuje, akore oino aroe Eimejera kana ure imi, iwo boe eedo, iwo boe ewogwado, uwo iaboe etudo iwogai iwo moci barigu pijidu bogai? Taerdu nure aidui turugoduwo ii duji!

Pao utugare Eliseu, tumearudui israeldoge eimejera ui tugudae bowuje dukeje, ure ia boe emagodo nowu brae eimejeraji kodiba are akudae bowuje? Utudo iwogai, jorduwawo ia profetaie ure Israeldoge etada duji.
Icare Naaman aregodure tagu kowarudoge ebo, to imarido tabo, ure tuwuredo Eliseu uwaiporo keje.
Icare Eliseure ia tudugare akodo oino ji akaimo Jordão po tada ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto, dutabore akodu pemegadodumode.

Icare Naaman uture tugorigodu tabo, tagoi oino dutabo imearudaere umoduie tuiebu, umoduie turagojedo iogorai, okwa magudu moduie to Aroe Eimejera ieji, umoduie tugera aogado icebae keje, dutabo moci okwa moduie pi tuku je duji! Damasco kejewu pobodoge, Abana Pobo, Parpar Pobo, epemega kodu modukana Israel kejewu pobodoge ekori? Iroiwa modukana iwo itaimo eto, iwo irugadu?
Du kodi Icare, ure tugirimi paci je, boekorii pudui dutabo.
Mare utugarege ere tuburedo ji, egore ji ioga, Profetamode ado ia boe biarewu towuje ma, amodukana towuje? Kode, akore ai 'Akaimo, akodu pemegadodumode', kodiba arokare ino?
Du kodi Icare ure turawuje, ure taora tugu ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto nowu Jordão poto, nowu Pao utugare ako magadu reore, Icare kodure nono ia boe etore kugure ekodure. Pemegagodure!

Icare ure tugirimi tudugarege eiamedu apo nowu Pao utugare ae. Taregodui ae dukeje, ure turagojedo jokorai, akore oinore Icare iorduware ia Aroe Eimejera bokwae Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera piji. Inogwa magudu nure ai akergu atugare ia o mearoguji.
Eliseu akore oino imaragodure aiwu Ikimejera ie tabo imagomode ai itaidukare iaboe iaboeji. Naamã ako kudure ji, mare aidukare tuwo tugeragu ji.

Du kodi Icare Naamã akore oino ji kode, ido ia burudoge emode pobe edo ia moto reko itabo du bogai; paga karega, awu piji, atugare imidu imodukare inomeado ia aroe eimejerage etai, Aroe Eimejera remawu piji.
Nowu du kodi, Atália, Acazias uce, tumearudui tonaregedu bi jitu keje, aidure tuwo brae eimejera otobijiwuge eeda kedodo.

Mare Josabá, brae eimejera Jorão naregedu aredu, Acazias uwie, ure tugeragu Joasji, Acazias naregedu, ure reko, ucarugo pega apo, nowu brae eimejera ore epiji, duwugere ewidodumode tuba keje, ure biado Atália piji, oinore ure cinorudo tuwi piji.
Biadodure Josabá apo jorui ikera awubodure buture taci ikera awubowuto mito, Pao uwai tada, brae eimejeragoi Atália cedu tonaji.

Jorure ikera awubodure pobe taci ikera awubowuto dukeje, Joiada makore tugobaigarege eimejerage ewogai, ure etarego pudae Pao uwaito; ure ewududo tuwadaru keje, tui eerdudo brae eimejera naregedu jitu tabo.
Tugobaigarege eimejerage erore nono nowu Pao bure joia iere Joiada cedu makore jiboe rekodaji. Ere tugeragu tudugarege maragodureugei, maragodukareugei, eture puapo Pao bure joia Joiada bogai.
Nowu Pao bure joiare brae eimejera Davi ure ona onado pudui turugodu tabowu meriri otorewu, meriri aiarewu jetu iworire Pao uwai tadadu maku etai.
Nowu tugobaigarege ere tudo turugadu turagojerewu boe keje tuiedui nowu turugodumode tabo boeji, ere tuwirido nowu Pao uwai tada tuwo tugera braredo brae eimejeraji jice woje jaogwai.

Du kejere Pao burejoiare brae eimejera onaregedu je bu, ure ao kejewu tugu aoto, ure brae eimejerage ekedu ekedure jiboe maku ai, dutabo Icare ure brae eimejerado ema, ure boe kaguru maedo aora joki. Jeture nonowu oieiwuge ere tugera to pui toiogwari tabo paegarewo pagimejera kurireuji!
Atália, tumearudui boe egoi toiogwari tabodu jitu keje, ure tuburedo toro ei, Pao uwai tada.
Aiwore, jordure, brae eimejera rakojere tumuga keje. Urareuge, okwa akoreuge, eedure nowu brae eimejera jekai; nowu boe eiamedu eegarere togwa akoi meriri iworewu jitu tabo.
Tuiordui nowu jitu keje, ure tugudae bowuje toiogwari tabo, akore enure ieto pui! Enure ie to pui!
Mare nowu Pao burejoia Joiada makore nowu tugobaigaregei, tagoi oino dutabo udo turodo oino boe epiji; kodumode apowuge eiamedu boe ewimode tariga rairewu tabo. Aidukare biwo Pao uwai tada.
Du kodi Icare, ere tuwure onado ji kawarudoge ere turemo jiwu awaraji; uture nowu tumuga brae eimejera uwai kae, nonore Icare bitodure.
Joiadare brae eimejera udo tuwadaru maku nowu jeture nonowuge eie tabo Pao ai Pao uwobemode Israeldogece; ure boe, brae eimejera, edo tuwadaru maku puai jamedu.

Du keje Icare eiamedu boe eture Baal uwai kae, ere pegado. Ere nowu ira boe, nowu aroe eimejerage rugadu pegado, ere kado, ere Baal bure joia iere Matan cedu bito, Du keje Icare, Pao bure joia Joiada ure ia tugobaigarege eedudo nono tuietu tabo Pao uwaiji.
Nowu boe eiamedu boe eegarere, dutabo nowu bakurirewu boe makodure keje. Paga karega Atália bitodure tariga rairewu tabo Boe Eimejera uwai kurirewu tada.
Nowu du kodi, Assíria kejewu brae eimejera kurirewu Salmanasar ure turemo nowu moto jamedu boe kao, aregodure Samaria kae, ure bakuredo tabo joru pobe ma jewu metuia bokware.

Oséias jetui Israeldogei jorure ikera awubodure pobe puibiji taci ikera awubowuto dukeje, nowu Assíria kejewu brae eimejera ure tugeragu Samaria motoji, ure Israeldoge erego Assíria kae, Ure eedudo Halá moto keje, Habor, Gazan kejewu, pobo okwa keje, Média kejewu bakurireuge etada jamedu.
Oinore ure, mare paga karega, Israeldoge ero pegare to Aroe Eimejera ji kodi. Ure etawuje Egito moto piji, Egito kejewuge eimejera kurirewu Faraó iera piji, kodi karega.
Ekodure ia boe eerduwakare jiwu aroe eimejerage eregodaji, ere Paore ewarigu Israeldoge etore epijiwuge eno aroedoge eparudo, ere Israeldoge eimejeragere aregowu aroedoge eparudo jamedu.
Mare Paore Israeldoge, Judá kejewuge ewie profetadoge eiabiji, baire eiamedu boe eiabiji, tagoi oino dutabo:
Tagirimi taro pegarewu jamedu boe piji, tarodo nono ii taroiagudu reore, du ire maku tagai itugarege eiabiji, ino profetadoge eiabiji.
Mare ewiapagakare akoi puduiduji; paci oino, ere tugidoru rakaguragado, tododaiwuge eromagadu reore, tumearutoru kai to Aroe Eimejera jitu tabo.
Ere tumejodo ui boe eroiagudu piji, ui tuwadaru maku tuomage etai dupiji.
Du kodire Pao korigodu kuricigore Israeldogei, ure ewarigudu jaegirido tubiji. Judá uwobere eedure tu rugadu.
Nowu du kodiboe keje, Assíria kejewu brae eimejera Senaquerib, ure ia tudugare rojai Ezequias bogai, tagoi oino dutabo:
Amearutorure jiwu ako Aroe Eimejera ukawo aekiri pagado tui amearutorudo Jerusalém makudu modukae Assíria kejeu brae eimejera iera kae duji.
Icá, akire aerduware inoba Assíria kejewu brae eimejerage eroi awu moto kejewu boe ji duji, tui etagedudo dutabo. Kode, inoba amode akinorudo?
Ezaquias ure tugeragu nowu baperaji aregodure tabowuge ekera piji, makore jitu rekodaji, ure turemo Pao uwaito, ure nowu bapera jado Pao jekai.
Okwamagudure oino Pao jekai Pagimejera Israeldoge Eimejera, amugure tupadoge ewugejewu, akire Pao Aroe Eimejerare aki mito tu je, boe eiamedu boe eimejerage ekori; akire are baru, moto, towuje.
Aejodo awiapaga tabo cedae, awiapagado, aeku jodo, akaiwodo; awiapagado Senaqurib akoi cei duji tuwo boe eredugodudo ai.

Boe jokodu, Assíria kejewu brae eimejerage ere boe eiamedu boe epegado, ere eno aroe eimejerage ewarigu joruto; mare paga karega Aroe Eimejera remawu karega ure emage, mare ime ekerare toboe, ira, tori, du kodire eroiware tuwo epegado.
Mare oino, ceno Aroe Eimejera, ceginorudo ekera piji; padure pumekejewu brae, brae eimejerage, eerduwado akie tu rugadu Pao Aroe Eimejerare aki duji.
Du kodi Icare Isaías, Amós onaregedu, ure boe emagodo Ezequias ji: Oinore Pao Israeldoge eno Aroe Eimejera akore 'akogwamagudui iwogai Assíria kejewu brae eimejera jiboe aregodure itae. '

Oinore Pao akore ji, tui tugogado jitu tabo: 'Sião onaregedu unure awarigodudo ai, unure towari omeado ai, Jerusalém onaregedu aredu unure tao magadudo bai bai akujeto; Paga karega, ia jetureuge emode turawuje Jerusalém piji, ia jeture kimowuge emode tudawuje Sião torekodu piji. Tugobaigarege eimejera Pao imaredu koiare umode boedo oino.
Du kodire Icare Pao akore oino Assíria kejewu brae eimejeraji umodukare turemo awu bakurireuto, umodukare tugo barigu ji, utu modukare togi meriri aiarewu tabo, umodukare motoiado oiei jamedu.
Aregodure jiwu awara, umode tugirimi ji tuibagi, tukai turemo bakurireuto dutabo. - Oinore Pao akore -
Ietumode awu bakurireuji, imode udo Cinorudo, ikie koia, itugare Davi koia.
Ca, kode! Ia boecoji, Pao o tupare turawuje, ure imere 1. 0 etogorido Assíria kejewuge ere baadodu keje.
Du kodi Icare, Assíria kejewu brae eimejera Senaqurib, ure turagojedo ture baadodu piji, du kodi Icare ure tugirimi, mugure Nínive bakurirewu keje.
Nowu du kodi brae eimejera Ezequias ia kogodae jeture ji. Icare profeta Isaias, Amós naregedu, uture ae, akore ji boe pemegado awai keje, awimode, amodukare ae kirimi aibagi pugeje.
Icare nowu brae eimejerare tuie kirimi motorito, okwamagudure oino Pao ji:
Ino Aroe Eimejera, awiabutudo ikodui aegai iwabo jetorogodu tabo, iroi akaidu reore duji.
Du keje Icare Ezequias ragudu kuricigore. Isaias ukare tuiebu nowu bororo piji kimo dutabo, Pao bataru aregodure ae tagoi oino dutabo:

Akirimi amagowo iwobe eimejera Ezequias ji oinore ao Davi o Aroe Eimejera akore imearudure akogwa maguduji, iorudure peguruji. Icá, inure apemegago, meri ma jewu metuia bokware durekodaji arudumode Aroe Eimejera uwai kae.

Imode aragoje kimodo jorumode ikera pudogidure iwure awubodure. Imode akinorudo Síria kejewu brae eimejera iera piji, awo bakurirewu apo. Ikera padumode awu bakurirewu aogeje, igoia, itugare Davi koia.
Nowu du kodiboe keje, Pao bure joia Helcias akore bapera epa Safã ji iordure Pao uwai tada o boe eroiagudu padure kejewu baperaji. Helcias ure nowu bapera maku Safã ai, dure makore ji.

Du kejere nowu bapera epa Safã ure tugirimi brae eimejera ae, ure boe jamedu boe kagado biagai, akore ji atugarege ere tugeragu jeture Pao uwai tadawu diieroji, ere maku maragodureuge eimejerage etai, emaragoduwo nono Pao uwai tada.
Du keje Icare, nowu bapera epa akore oino brae eimejeraji Pao bure joia Helciare ia bapera makuinai. Icare Safã makore ji brae eimejera jekai.
Nowu brae eimejera, tumearudui boe eroiagudu padui nowu bapera kejedu jitu keje, ure tugudae bowuje.
Care akore oino Pao bure joia Helciasji, Safã onaregedu Acaim ji, Miqueias onaregedu Acbor ji, bapera epa Safã ji, tudugobaigarege eimejera Asias ji, akore.

Toro Pao ae, tagogwa gunorado ji, ikie tabo, boe ekie tabo, Judá kejewuge eiamedu boe ekie tabo, awu boe eerdure jiwu bapera akoino jiboeji. Paga karega, Pao korigodu pega kuricigore pai, paomage emearutorukai awu bapera akoino jitu koia, erokai nono padure kejeboe reore, du kodi.
Du kodi Icare ure Judá kejewu, Jerusalém kejewu codureuge eiamedu boe eto pui pudae.

Du tabo Icare nowu brae eimejera uture Pao uwaito. Nowu Judá kejewu boe eiamedu boe, Jerusalém kejewu boe eiamedu boe ekodure apo, Pao bure joiage, maragodure Pao uwai tadawuge eiamedu boe, boe eiamedu boe, kurireuge, biegareuge, ekodure apo jamedu. Nonore Icare ure boe emagodo boe eerdure jiwu padure Pao o bapera kejewu bataru jamedu boeji boe ewiagai.

Du keje Icare, nowu brae eimejera ure turagojedo ia ira aogeje, ure tuwadaru maku Pao ai, tugodumoduie Pao utawaraji, turomoduie ui boe eroiagudu jamedu boe rekodaji, turomoduie nono Pao bataru padui nowu bapera kejedu jamedu boe reore. Icare nowu boe eiamedu boe ere tuiodo nowu inodu keje.
Jaoquim o jorure 18 braei tugimejerado ema dukeje, arire pobe ma jewu metuia bokware tu je brae eimejerai ema Jerusalém keje. Uce iere Noesta, Jerusalém kejewu Elnatã onaregedu nure ema.
Ro pegare Pao jekai, tuo ro jamedu reore.
Nowu du kodiboe keje, Nabucodonosor, Babilônia kejewuge eimejera kurirewu utugobaigarege erudure Jerusalém togi, ere bakuredo ji.
Nowu Babilônia kejewuge eimejera kurirewu Nabucodonosor aregodure nowu utugarege ei bakuredo nowu bakurirewu tabo dukeje.

Du tabore Icare Joaquim, Judá kejewu brae eimejera, uture nowu Babilônia kejewu brae eimejera ae, tuje apo, tudugarege eiamedu boe ebo. Mare nowu Babilônia kejewu brae eimejera ure iera gogudo, jorure 8 brae eimejerai pudumi dutabo.

Ure Pao uwai tadawu oroe jamedu boe reko, ure nowu brae eimejera uwai tadawu oroe jamedu boe reko, Pao bataru rekodaji. Ure Israeldoge eimejera Salomãore towuje Pao uwai tadaboe cewu meriri ekurewu jamedu rugadu pegado, kobokobodo.

Ure Jerusalém kejewuge eiamedu boe, boe eimejerage eiamedu boe, tugobaigarege eiamedu boe, jorduware tumaragodae jiwuge eiamedu boe, maragodure meriri jiwuge eiamedu boe etowuje pudabo. Marenarue eire ukare tugeragu tu rugadu.
Ure Joaquim iera gogudo tui reko Babilônia kae. Ure brae eimejera uce, uwire, erego Jerusalém piji, Babilônia kae. Ure nowu moto kejewu kurireuge eiamedu boe erego pudabo jamedu.
Tugobaigarege ere 7. ; jorduware tumaragodae jiwuge, maragodure meriri jewuge ere 1... Rugodureuge nure eiamedu boece, duwugere ure erego to moto piji, nowu bakurirewu kae.
Babilônia kejewu brae eimejera ure Joaquim umana Matanias mugudo mugato, ure iedo Sedecias.

Jorui ikera awubodure buture ikera awubowuto pobe puibiji brae eimejerai Sedecias cedu keje, meri butui ikera pudogidure, ari butui ikera pudogidu reore dukejere, Babilônia kejewu brae eimejera Nabucodonosor uture tudugobaigarege eiamedu boebo Jerusalém togi, ure bakuredo tabo; ure motoiado oiei.
Du kodi Icare nowu bakurirewu bakuredodure jii Sedecias brae eimejerai jorure ikera pudogidure buture ikera awubowuto mito du kae.

Arire pobe puibiji, meri buture ikera awubowuto pobe puibiji dukeje, boe eke boi buture bakurirewu tadawuge ewugeje; boe eke bokware boe etai, du kodire ere tugeragu nowu bakurireuji. Du kodire boe eimejera rekododure boecoji tudugobaigarege eiamedu boe, ere tuiebu baiporoji moto ri okwa joi pudogi dukeje, mugure brae eimejera okureboe pa puredu, nowu Caldeudoge ei bakuredo bakurirewu apo dutabo, eture boe makodurewu jaogwai.
Mare Caldeia kejewu tugobaigarege eture nowu brae eimejera rekodaji, etaregodure ae Jericó o boe boarewu keje. Utugobaigarege eregodure piji, ere taodo boe joki.
Nowu Brae eimejera rema, ere tugeragu ji, ere reko Rebda kae, Babilônia kejeu brae eimejera jekai, dure ure tugogado ji.
Ure boedo Sedecias ore ewido tuiegai, ure boedo bure gogudo, ure boedo reko Babilônia kae.

Merire ikera awubodure butui ikera awubowuto pobe, arire ikera awubodure dukeje, Nabucodonosor, Babilônia kejewu brae eimejerai jorure 19 dukeje, tugobaigarege eimejera Nabusardan aregodure Jerusalém kae.
Ure joru tugu Pao uwaito, brae eimejera uwaito, ure joru tugu baidogeto, bai kurireuge eto jamedu.
Ure mugure apowu tugobaigarege edo nowu moto ri ui bakuredo Jerusalém apodu jamedu boe butudo.
Jeture nowu Jerusalém kejewu boe, rekodure Babilônia kejewu brae eimejera aiwuge, boe kobo, nowu tugobaigarege eimejera Nabusardanre erego.
Nowu moto kejewu marenarue epijire, iage ukare erego, emaragoduwo moto keje.
